page.metaDescription: 375°F = 190.6°C (Gas Mark 5). Baking times for pies, casseroles, fish and scones, plus fan and air fryer conversions.
page.tagline: Convert 375 degrees Fahrenheit to Celsius, find what to bake at 375°F with times for pies, casseroles, fish and scones, and compare fan oven and air fryer settings.
page.customIntro: 375 degrees Fahrenheit equals 190.6 degrees Celsius (about 190°C), calculated as (375 − 32) × 5/9 = 190.6°C. In recipes this is rounded to 190°C and corresponds to Gas Mark 5. It is a common baking and roasting temperature for fruit pies, casseroles, fish fillets, and scones, because it browns the surface while cooking food through.

why375.title: Why 375°F Is a Common Baking Temperature
why375.paragraph1: 375°F (190.6°C) sits between the gentle 350°F (177°C) used for cakes and delicate cookies and the high 400°F (204°C) used for pizza and roasted vegetables. At this middle temperature, the Maillard browning reaction colors the surface golden before the interior overcooks, which makes it ideal for foods that need a browned crust but a moist center.
why375.paragraph2: American recipes default to 375°F for fruit pies, casseroles, fish fillets, and scones. Above 400°F these foods can burn outside while staying raw inside; below 350°F they brown too slowly and can turn dry. 375°F is the balance point most home ovens reach reliably.

formula.note: Quick estimate: (375 − 30) ÷ 2 = 172.5°C — off by about 18°C, so do not use this shortcut for oven temperatures. Oven settings should be precise.

faq.question: Is 375°F the same as 190°C or 191°C?
faq.answer: 375°F converts to exactly 190.56°C. Most ovens display 190°C, and some recipes round up to 191°C. Either setting will produce the same result, since the 1°C difference is within normal oven fluctuation.

faq.question: Do I need to adjust cooking time in a fan oven at 375°F?
faq.answer: Yes. Set a fan or convection oven to about 355°F (171°C) and shorten the cooking time by 10-15%. Fan ovens circulate hot air faster, so food cooks more quickly — check doneness 2-3 minutes before the recipe's stated time.

faq.question: Can I bake bread at 375°F?
faq.answer: 375°F works for soft sandwich loaves and rolls, which bake in 25-30 minutes. Crusty artisan and sourdough bread needs a hotter oven (425°F and up) to spring and form a hard crust, so save 375°F for tender baked goods.

faq.question: What is the difference between 350°F and 375°F for baking?
faq.answer: 350°F (177°C) is gentler, giving cakes and cookies time to rise and set without over-browning. 375°F (190°C) browns faster, which suits pies, casseroles, fish, and scones that benefit from a golden crust. Using 375°F for a cake recipe often over-browns the outside before the center sets.
